title: Primitive envelope
description: One primitive of a style's grammar: a property the style animates and the measured range of every parameter it takes. A style keeps its envelopes in grammar.json as { "primitives": [ ... ] }, and validate-plan.mjs checks every grammar-composed tween against them. Ranges are the observed minimum to maximum widened by measurement error, never a guess.

property.description: The animated property as GSAP names it: opacity, x, y, scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, clipPath, filter, and so on.

absent.description: True when the source never animates this property. A tween on it is then a violation, because restraint is part of the hand.

family.description: The curve family the fitted moves fall into.

curves.description: Names of the easings in tokens.json this property is seen on.

duration_units.description: Tween duration in the style's timing unit.

vo_offset_s.description: Seconds from the voice-over word the move answers to the move's start. Negative leads the word.

stagger_units.description: Stagger between siblings, in timing units.

travel_frac.description: Travel as a share of the frame along the axis of motion (x against width, y against height).

overshoot.description: Peak overshoot past the target as a share of the travel.

source_moves.description: Library moves this envelope was measured from.
